narrative_purpose: Show the arms race as a measurable exchange rather than a metaphor: a hunter's call sweeping ahead of it while the small prey it is hunting drops out of the sky before the hunter arrives.
subject: A night sky containing two animals. A larger winged nocturnal hunter sweeps through the upper middle of the frame, its mouth open, with a series of faint widening concentric arcs spreading forward from its head into the space ahead of it, suggesting sound travelling outward. Below and ahead of it, a small moth-like winged insect is caught mid-tumble in a sudden spiralling power-off dive, its wings folded, dropping clear of the arcs. The empty air where the insect used to be sits directly in the hunter's path.
scene: Open night air, no ground visible, only deep darkness with a faint scattering of high haze and a few distant pinpricks of cool bioluminescent light.
camera: Mid shot from the side, both animals in frame, the gap between them the visual subject.
light: Very low ambient night light. The concentric sound arcs are faintly self-luminous cool cyan; the insect carries a tiny warm accent so the eye can find it against the dark.
palette: Near-black indigo dominating, faint cyan arcs, one small warm amber accent on the diving insect.
style: Painterly naturalist night plate, quiet and observed, closer to a field study than an action scene.
detail_level: Crisp on both animals; the sound arcs faint and soft-edged; the surrounding air empty and dark.
composition: Hunter across the upper third moving left to right, insect low and ahead of it dropping on a steep diagonal, large plain dark areas in the lower left and upper right framed by deep negative space.
consistency_notes: The concentric arcs must read as soft painted haze spreading from the hunter's head, never as a graphic radar symbol or icon. The insect must be clearly already falling, wings folded, and clearly outside the arcs - the picture is about the escape happening before contact.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no radar or sonar icons, no graphic sound-wave symbols, no daylight, no green rainforest, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
